behavioral_signatures: Detection of speculative execution attacks that exploit shared branch predictor state between threads or processes.
Observation of branch predictor manipulation patterns consistent with Spectre-style side-channel attacks, such as repeated mispredictions or cross-context branch history interference.
Unusual or unexpected sharing of branch predictor state between security domains (e.g., between user and kernel, or between different processes/VMs).

detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor hardware performance counters and side-channel analysis tools for patterns indicative of speculative execution attacks leveraging shared branch predictor state. Look for abnormal branch misprediction rates or cross-domain branch history interference. Employ code analysis or runtime instrumentation to verify that branch predictor partitioning (such as the Half&Half mitigation) is applied, especially in environments where sensitive data may be at risk from cross-thread or cross-process leakage.
